verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a mobile SSH/Mosh terminal and code client, so managing remote coding-agent tasks from a phone is a fair question for it. The evidence documents only terminal, SSH/Mosh, file and VS Code/Codespaces connectivity. Nothing shows a built-in capability to manage or track cloud coding-agent tasks, and SSHing into a server to run agents manually is a user-side workaround that earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage and track cloud-based coding agent tasks from my phone
